article.title: Trump reveals striking detail in ‘first’ detailed look at White House ballroom interior
article.summary: President shows off detailed concept art illustrating the inside of his $600 million pet project, revealing a cavernous space with marble flooring, chandeliers and more than a hint of Mar-a-Lago

article.title: BBC Presenter Laughs as Trump Security Blunder Revealed
article.summary: Police responsible for President Donald Trump’s safety have becomea laughing stock.The president, 80, hasbeen in Irelandover the weekend for a golf-oriented visit to his Doonbeg resort in County Clare to watch the Irish Open.Local gardaí police officers were part of the security operationduring the trip, but two of them made an awkward mistake while on duty when they started discussing the details of their operation with a journalist.Read more at The Daily Beast.

article.title: Laughter erupts as BBC reveals Trump security foibles: 'I do believe it!'
article.summary: Law enforcement tasked with protecting President Donald Trump mistakenly talked tactics with a random cameraman, the BBC revealed Sunday.BBC News reporter Enda McClafferty discussed the incident during a recent on-air interview about Trump's ongoing trip to Ireland, where the president has already spurredan international uproar,mass protestsand questions abouthis cognitive health."Yesterday two gardaí flagged down our camera man and mistook him for an undercover Garda officer," he said, "and started to talk tactics to him!"The host of BBC's Sunday Politics began to chuckle as McClafferty explained it was the cameraman who told the gardaí he was actually a journalist.Trump's security has caused a large headache for Ireland law enforcement.
